∀ (s : State) (e : Event), e.injected = 0 → (step s e).active ≤ s.active
∀ (s : State) (es : List Event), admissibleTrace s es → total (run s es) = total s + injected es
∀ (s : State) (xs ys : List Event), run s (xs ++ ys) = run (run s xs) ys
∀ (s : State) (xs ys : List Event), admissibleTrace s (xs ++ ys) → admissibleTrace s xs
∀ (s : State) (es : List Event), admissibleTrace s es → (run s es).collected ≤ total s + injected es
